name: leafkin_druid_adds_two_with_four_creatures
notes: The other branch of leafkin_druid_pays_from_the_menu: controlling four or more creatures, Leafkin Druid adds {G}{G} instead, so it alone pays Greenwood Sentinel ({1}{G}) from the menu. The payer prices the Conditional by the branch the state picks as the ability is activated (a mana ability resolves at once, CR 605.3a-b).
